items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: At the time, I was with Paul Barberin, and, well, they asked me, they offered me the job.

ctx.x: Because I was with Paul Barberin.

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Yeah, we worked together with Paul.

ctx.x: Well, he played up there with us too. I mean back in the old days. Well, I used to get jobs before that, you know. Well, I used to get jobs and I used to hire him. I ain't the hell not. Did you like his trumpet play? Yeah.
They worked together with Paul Barberin too. Yeah, we worked together with Paul. I mean anything back in the 30s, back then. No.

Oh, more about the Joe Longagne. I know nothing about him except he led a brass band. Did he play dance bands too? Yeah. I used to play jobs when he set up. What kind of trumpet player was he? Was he a straight man or played variations? No, no. I was mostly a straight band. I see. Did he just use orchestrations or would he play some Dixieland numbers? He used to play Dixieland numbers.
